Perfect! I've successfully navigated to the **Classic Blueberry Scones** recipe on Coded Culinary. Here are the details:

## Recipe Overview
- **Title:** Classic Blueberry Scones
- **Author:** Chef Maria
- **Published:** October 15, 2025
- **Category:** Breakfast & Brunch
- **Difficulty:** Easy
- **Estimated Read Time:** 4 minutes

## Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 3/4 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg

## Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C)
2. Mix dry ingredients together
3. Cut in butter until crumbly
4. Fold in blueberries
5. Add cream and egg
6. Shape into rounds and cut into wedges
7. Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden

## Glaze
- Mix 1 cup powdered sugar with 2 tablespoons milk

Enjoy your warm blueberry scones! The recipe also mentions there are other variations available if you're interested in vegan or gluten-free options.
